daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿تَبَّتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿يَدا﴾ fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is dual. ﴿أَبِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَهَبٍ﴾ also muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَبَّ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أَغْنى﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مالُهُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ a relative noun, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ماله. ﴿كَسَبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿سَيَصْلى﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ناراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذاتَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of نارا. ﴿لَهَبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَامْرَأَتُهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle (ḥarf istiʾnāf), and mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَمَّالَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «أذم حمالة» (I censure the carrier). ﴿الْحَطَبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فِي جِيدِها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿حَبْلٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ مَسَدٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of حبل; the clause «امرأته..» is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. The verbal clause ﴿أذم حمالة الحطب﴾ is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa), with no grammatical position.
